input.prompt: Original Building Suit headquarters exterior concept. Polished stylized 3D game-world illustration with a subtle pixel-art influence, tactile small-scale materials, warmly lit windows, clean readable architectural forms; not a flat vector drawing and not photorealistic. Three-quarter orthographic view from the front-right, whole structure visible on a compact landscaped base. A tall modular three-tier building with an iconic corporate crown carrying the exact words BUILDING SUIT. The top occupied tier is the CEO penthouse; HR is immediately below. The lower architectural tier is unassigned, pending the founder deciding its purpose; no extra department or employee is implied. No characters or people at this exterior-design stage, no UI, labels, task counters or simulated work. Original building architecture: a memorable ambitious landmark silhouette, without Marvel logos or copying Avengers Tower. 3:4 portrait composition, identical camera, overall proportions and scale across the three concept variants. Leave enough clear space around the complete building. Brand colors and architecture are proposals for visual review, not a change to the company brand or business logic. Variant B, Living Headquarters: pale stone, deep teal glass, carefully planted terraces, distinct stepped tiers and an elegant rooftop crown. Soft daylight, small trees, warm interior glow and a refined landscaped base. Welcoming contemporary architecture with the same tall proportions as the other variants; no houses, village or scattered standalone buildings.
